citation.title: Co-Optimization of Structure and Manufacturable Semi-Continuous Layers for Laminated Composites
citation.authors: Tao Liu, Aoran Lyu, Yongxue Chen, Yu Jiang, Michael J. Petty, and Charlie C. L. Wang
citation.version_coded: abstract only; author project page full paper link to ACM was inaccessible

claim.primary_outcome_paraphrase: The abstract reports up to 43.8% higher stiffness for optimized fabric-reinforced composites than counterparts made with planar fabric plies.
claim.claimed_speedup_basis: No speed factor is reported in accessible abstract/project text.
claim.alternatives: The project page says the framework jointly optimizes topology and manufacturable layers and validates results with numerical simulations and physical experiments.

baseline.quality_metric: stiffness; FEA and physical experiments described on author project page
baseline.quality_gap: Up to 43.8% higher stiffness versus planar-ply counterparts (abstract)

notes: The author project page links to the ACM paper (403 Forbidden) and to a public code repository; no full text was reachable from the project page or ACM link. Abstract and author project/code pages only were used. Abstract reports quality versus planar-ply counterparts, while no classical optimization comparator is stated in the accessible abstract; I-UNCLEAR is used and the stratum remains none under the no-full-text access rule.
